direction_diagnostics.echo_positive:
Casual, informal tone with dialogue format ("A story about") suggesting a response or continuation of a written prompt about depression and life.

The phrase "no numbered or formatted answer here, just plain text" signals a closing prompt structure, likely followed by the actual written response body continuing the prose paragraph about the topic, possibly with elaboration or continuation of the thought.

Final token "text\n" closes a disclaimer header ("no numbered or formatted answer here..."), part of a block format header pattern ("Here is my plain prose"), strongly expecting continuation like "The answer is:" or "I'll write" or "This paragraph flows naturally" or "My response follows."
direction_diagnostics.echo_negative:
Chat format with structured emoji response pattern ("#️⃣ Question:" and "##️⃣ Answer:") signals a platform UI or thread template.

The text "Copy the following markdown to your response" signals a second attempt to format the list of points, likely closing the post with a formatted reply or bullet points, continuing the same structure as the original prompt.

Final token "response\n" closes a markdown block header ("\[Answer]"), immediately expecting the opening of the actual reply content or continuation of the list format, likely "1. " or "Here is my response:" or "The following points:" to complete the prompt structure.
